_note: Real floor tiles from carrea.pl, collected 2026-11-15 for the floor material configurator. Faces are the shop's flat straight-on product images (largest available, no room scenes). face_is_full_tile=true means the image is (or very likely is) one whole tile face at the right aspect ratio; false means a crop or a face of a different format, see notes. Most scans are seamless, so tile edges are not drawn in the image. finish: 'natural' = manufacturer's 'naturale' matte surface, 'mat' = matte. price_pln_m2 is the shop's current price per m² incl. VAT (null = price on request). Shop wording kept in color_pl / availability_pl. Entries added 2026-11-15 by the stone/tile pass carry 'shop', 'sku' (EAN or manufacturer code) and 'fetched'; their faces live in source/refs/tiles/<shop>/<slug>/. Render params: maxpx caps the texture side, grout_w is the joint width in m (2 mm rectified, 3 mm non-rectified, 4 mm tumbled stone), bond is the row offset, shape 'hex' switches to the hexagon layout, flat removes the scan's lighting gradient (quadratic fit) so rotated faces do not form a patchwork. 'cat' here is the catalogue category (tile, concrete or stone).
source: carrea.pl; domus-sklep.pl; castorama.pl; paradyz.com (see each entry's url/shop)

tiles.name: Medley White Rock 60×60
tiles.notes: Ergon (Emil Group). White terrazzo with large white marble shards on light ground; 28 random face patterns in production. face-1 = 60×60 face (506 px, low-res). face-2/3 = left/right halves of the 1200×600 face of the sibling Medley White Rock 60×120 (same design and scale), added for variation. Scans are seamless, tile edges not visible. Listed as 'produkt na wyczerpaniu' (running out). Old price 169 zł/m², 129 zł/m² is a promo.
